gradingSystem.label: AEGRYN — Grading System
gradingSystem.title:
AEGRYN
Grading System.
gradingSystem.intro: Il protocollo AEGRYN Grade è lo standard di certificazione per gli asset digitali tech in Europa. Ispirato agli standard orologieri svizzeri e adattato al mercato SaaS M&A, produce una valutazione riproducibile, tracciabile e indipendente.
gradingSystem.cifsDesc: Ogni asset è valutato secondo quattro dimensioni indipendenti, ciascuna con un punteggio da 0 a 25 punti. Il punteggio totale su 100 determina il grade.

cifs.name: Code
cifs.desc: Qualità del codice sorgente, copertura dei test, debito tecnico, documentazione, sicurezza dell'implementazione e architettura scalabile.

cifs.name: IP
cifs.desc: Proprietà intellettuale, barriere all'ingresso, marchi registrati, brevetti e differenziazione sostenibile.
criteria: Dipendenze di terze parti con licenze compatibili
Contratti clienti con clausole di non concorrenza

cifs.name: Finance
cifs.desc: Metriche finanziarie chiave: ARR, MRR, churn, LTV/CAC, burn rate, runway e crescita. Tutti i dati sono verificati su documenti.

cifs.name: Security
cifs.desc: Conformità GDPR e LPD svizzero, sicurezza dell'infrastruttura, gestione degli accessi e governance dei dati.
criteria: Autenticazione MFA su tutti gli accessi admin
Dati cifrati a riposo e in transito
Audit di sicurezza terzi negli ultimi 18 mesi
Politica di gestione degli incidenti documentata

gradingSystem.gradesDesc: Ogni grade corrisponde a un preciso intervallo di punteggio e a un profilo di asset definito. AEG ★ e AAA sono assegnati a meno del 15% degli asset inviati.

grades.label: Stellar
grades.profile: Asset eccezionale. Architettura di riferimento, IP solida, metriche finanziarie top decile. Idoneo per transazioni istituzionali.
grades.typical: SaaS B2B ARR > 2M€, churn < 1%, copertura test > 90%.

grades.label: Premium
grades.profile: Asset di alta qualità con fondamentali solidi in tutte e quattro le dimensioni.
grades.typical: SaaS ARR > 500K€, crescita > 30% YoY, conformità GDPR completa.

grades.label: Standard
grades.profile: Asset di buona qualità con punti di forza identificati e aree di miglioramento documentate.
grades.typical: SaaS in crescita, alcune lacune in test o conformità.

grades.label: Developing
grades.profile: Asset in sviluppo con potenziale identificabile ma debolezze strutturali da affrontare.
grades.typical: Prodotto in early traction, debito tecnico significativo.

grades.label: Early Stage
grades.profile: Asset early stage con fondamentali parziali. Certificazione con report di remediation dettagliato.
grades.typical: MVP o prodotto pre-revenue, architettura non documentata.

gradingSystem.subcodesDesc: Ogni dimensione riceve un sotto-codice da M01 a M04 (Maturità) e D01 a D04 (Profondità).

subcodeTable.label: In corso
subcodeTable.desc: Sotto la mediana — aree di miglioramento identificate

subcodeTable.label: Remediation
subcodeTable.desc: Livello insufficiente — piano di remediation richiesto

gradingSystem.exampleDesc: Un asset con grade AAA e codice C1-D01 | I2-M02 | F1-A01 | S2 si legge così:

exampleItems.meaning: Code: livello di riferimento, analisi completa
Finance: riferimento, audit completo dei dati

process.title: Invio e prequalificazione
process.desc: Ricezione del fascicolo, verifica della completezza dei documenti. Prequalificazione entro 5 giorni lavorativi.

process.title: Analisi tecnica (Code + Security)
process.desc: Revisione del codice da parte di due ingegneri senior certificati AEGRYN. Scansione di sicurezza automatizzata e revisione manuale. Durata: 5–10 giorni.

process.title: Analisi commerciale (IP + Finance)
process.desc: Audit delle metriche finanziarie, verifica IP nei registri competenti. Colloquio con il fondatore. Durata: 5–10 giorni.

process.title: Deliberazione e co-firma
process.desc: I due analisti deliberano e producono un rapporto preliminare. Per AEG ★ e AAA, un co-firmatario partner valida il rapporto finale.

process.title: Emissione e ancoraggio blockchain
process.desc: Il grade viene emesso, firmato digitalmente e ancorato nel protocollo KRYV — sigillato in modo immutabile.

principles.title: Separazione rigorosa
principles.desc: Gli analisti AEGRYN non hanno interesse finanziario negli asset che certificano. Qualsiasi relazione con il titolare attiva la ricusazione automatica.

principles.title: Riproducibilità
principles.desc: Due analisti indipendenti devono raggiungere lo stesso grade (±1 sotto-codice). Una discrepanza maggiore attiva una procedura di arbitrato.

principles.title: Tracciabilità
principles.desc: Ogni grade è versionato. Qualsiasi revisione genera una nuova versione con tracciabilità completa della cronologia.

principles.title: Ricorso
principles.desc: Il titolare può contestare un grade entro 30 giorni. Il ricorso è istruito da un panel indipendente di tre analisti.

termsCgv.note: This document constitutes the binding contractual reference. Precise pricing conditions are specified in the signed mandate or quote between the parties.
termsCgv.defAegryn: AEGRYN Sàrl, a company registered in Switzerland (CHE-XXX.XXX.XXX).
termsCgv.defAsset: Any digital asset that may be certified and/or transferred via AEGRYN, including without limitation: software (SaaS, applications), codebases, digital intellectual property, trademarks associated with a digital asset, protocols.
termsCgv.defGrade: Official certification of a tech asset under the C/I/F/S protocol, co-signed by external partners. Grade awarded: ★, AAA, AA, A, B.

termsCgv.defPtt: Contractual mechanism governing the transfer of a certified asset, including a 10% bank escrow of the agreed price.
termsCgv.defEscrow: Amount deposited by the buyer with a third-party bank designated by AEGRYN. AEGRYN is never the custodian of these funds.
termsCgv.defSeller: Any natural or legal person submitting a tech asset to the AEGRYN process.
termsCgv.defBuyer: Any qualified AEGRYN member authorised to access the catalogue and submit offers.
termsCgv.s2Review: Written opinion from an AEGRYN analyst on a submitted tech asset. Timeline: 5 working days. Not co-signed, not publishable in the catalogue. Indicative value only. Fully deductible from certification fees if the full process is started within 6 months.
termsCgv.s2ReviewPlus: Written opinion from an AEGRYN analyst supplemented by an external partner review. Timeline: 10 working days. Not co-signed in the sense of official certification, not publishable. Fully deductible under the same conditions.
termsCgv.s2Cert: Full multi-dimensional audit process across all 4 C/I/F/S dimensions. Co-signed by a tech law firm, an accountant, a cybersecurity partner if applicable. Official AEG Grade awarded and publishable in the catalogue. Fees: success-based (commission on sale).
termsCgv.s2Advisory: Strategic and operational support for assets undergoing remediation and re-submission. Fees on quote.
termsCgv.s3: All assets are submitted via /grade/submit. Submission does not constitute a contractual commitment. AEGRYN has 5 working days to respond with a pre-screening. Less than 25% of submitted assets are accepted for full certification.
termsCgv.s3Oblig: The seller agrees to provide accurate and complete information, guarantee having the rights to transfer the asset, maintain confidentiality of the evaluation process, and not transfer the asset to a third party during the exclusive mandate period.
termsCgv.s4Ei: Non-binding. Transmitted by AEGRYN to the seller within 48 hours. No deposit required.

termsCgv.s4Escrow: Amount: 10% of the agreed transaction price. Payment deadline: 5 working days following HoA signature. Custodian: third-party bank designated by AEGRYN. Dual signature required for any release.
termsCgv.s4RetractBuyer: Buyer withdrawal without legitimate reason: escrow is awarded to the seller, less AEGRYN's handling commission.
termsCgv.s4RetractSeller: Seller withdrawal without legitimate reason: escrow is fully returned to the buyer. The seller additionally pays an indemnity equal to the escrow amount.
termsCgv.s4RetractSusp: Unfulfilled condition precedent (documented legitimate reason): escrow is fully returned to the buyer. The audit commission already paid remains due to AEGRYN.
termsCgv.s4Dd: Standard duration: 30 calendar days from escrow confirmation. The buyer accesses the full data room under NDA. Extension possible by mutual written agreement (maximum 30 additional days).
termsCgv.s4Signing: At signing: KRYV Protocol certifies the codebase state via blockchain fingerprint. The balance (90%) is paid by the buyer. The bank releases the escrow. AEGRYN deducts its commission and pays the net balance to the seller. AEGRYN issues the official Transaction Certificate.

termsCgv.s7: AEGRYN never discloses the seller's identity to the buyer, nor the buyer's identity to the seller, without explicit agreement of both parties. Transaction data published in the results catalogue is systematically anonymised.

privacy.label: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Like most businesses operating in the financial and transaction sector, AEGRYN collects and processes data relating to its clients, partners and others who may be interested in its services. This notice explains the type of data we process, why we process it and how this may affect you.
privacy.s1: The data controller is AEGRYN Sàrl, a company registered in Switzerland (CHE-XXX.XXX.XXX). When you use our services (certification, transaction, advisory, catalogue), the data controller is AEGRYN Sàrl.
privacy.s2Title: What data do we collect and how?
privacy.s2Direct: Name, professional contact details, entity information, financial information (investment capacity, proof of funds), identity documents, entity documents, beneficial owner (UBO) information. Collected during registration, asset submission, Alliance application, Assessment Day booking, use of the valuation calculator or any communication.
privacy.s2Auto: IP address, browser type, operating system, pages visited, visit duration — via cookies and similar technologies. See our Cookie Policy.
privacy.s2Third: Public registers, identity verification and fraud prevention services, sanctions and politically exposed persons (PEP) databases.
privacy.s3Title: Why do we process your data?
privacy.s3Row2Data: Identity, UBO, source of funds, PEP
privacy.s4: Within AEGRYN: team members with a legitimate operational need. Co-signatory partners: law firms, accountants, cybersecurity partners (subject to strict confidentiality obligations). Escrow bank: for escrow account management. Technical service providers: hosting, email, payment via Stripe. Authorities: when legally required. AEGRYN never sells your data to third parties.
privacy.s5: Data is hosted on servers in the European Union or Switzerland. For transfers to third countries, we implement appropriate safeguards (approved standard contractual clauses).
privacy.s6: We retain your data as long as necessary for service delivery, legal and regulatory compliance (AML obligations: minimum 10 years after end of commercial relationship), and protection against claims. Anonymised historical catalogue data is retained indefinitely.
privacy.s7: Under Swiss LPD and GDPR: rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability.
privacy.s8: Technical and organisational measures: encryption of sensitive data at rest and in transit, role-based access control (Supabase RLS), data room access logging, 2FA for admin access. In case of breach, notification of authorities and affected persons in accordance with Swiss LPD and GDPR.
privacy.s9: We use analytical cookies (Cloudflare Web Analytics, no personally identifiable data). No advertising cookies. You may decline analytical cookies via our consent banner.
privacy.s10: You have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority.

meta.title: FAQ — Frequently Asked Questions — AEGRYN
meta.desc: Answers to frequently asked questions about AEGRYN Grade certification, transactions, sessions and accounts.

items.a: The AEGRYN Grade is an official multi-dimensional certification evaluating 4 dimensions: Code (C), IP & Rights (I), Finance (F), Security (S). Each dimension is scored out of 25. The total score (out of 100) determines the official Grade: ★ Exceptional (≥90), AAA Excellent (≥75), AA Very Good (≥60), A Good (≥45), B Correct (≥30).

items.q: What is the difference between an official Grade and an estimated grade?
items.a: An official Grade is assigned after a real audit by AEGRYN analysts, co-signed by independent external partners (law firm, accountant, cybersecurity partner) who engage their professional liability. It can be published in the catalogue. An estimated grade (from /valuation or AEGRYN Review) is an indicative opinion based on declared data, always suffixed "(estimated)" with no contractual value.

items.q: How long does the certification process take?
items.a: AEGRYN Review: 5 working days after confirmed payment. AEGRYN Review+: 10 working days. Full Auction Certification: 3 to 5 weeks depending on asset complexity.

AEGRYN Review: €2,000 excl. VAT — deductible if full certification started within 6 months. AEGRYN Review+: €5,000 excl. VAT — same conditions. Auction Certification: free if transaction (AEGRYN earns commission on sale). Precise conditions in signed mandate.

items.q: My asset was declined. Can I resubmit?
items.a: Yes. Each refusal is accompanied by a detailed written report identifying areas for improvement. Our Advisory service can support you through remediation. A declined asset may be resubmitted at any time if documented improvements have been made.

KRYV Protocol is our blockchain certification infrastructure component. It generates a cryptographic fingerprint of the codebase at the exact date of certification and/or transfer, recorded immutably. This allows any buyer to prove at any future date that the code received matches exactly the certified code.

items.q: What types of assets can I submit?
items.a: AEGRYN certifies and transacts digital tech assets: B2B SaaS, mobile apps, marketplaces, AI protocols, digital intellectual property. Minimum ticket: €500,000 estimated valuation.

items.q: Will my identity be disclosed to buyers?
items.a: No. AEGRYN maintains the confidentiality of your identity throughout the process. It is only disclosed to the buyer after both parties' explicit agreement and AEGRYN's introduction decision.

items.q: How long does the exclusive mandate last?
items.a: 60 days, renewable by mutual agreement. After this period without a closed transaction, you regain full contractual freedom.

items.q: How do I become a member buyer?
items.a: Via the application form at /auction#membership. Your application is reviewed by AEGRYN within 10 working days. A 20–30 minute qualification interview is required. Financial capacity documents are necessary.

items.q: What is the minimum acquisition ticket?

items.a: AEGRYN offers 4 bid models: Club Deal (individual + up to 4 co-investors), Corporate (legal entity or JV), Fund (PE/VC/Family Office, IC timeline possible), Equity Stake (equity participation without full transfer). See /auction/bid-models for full details.
After a signed Heads of Agreement, the buyer deposits 10% of the agreed price with a third-party partner bank. AEGRYN never holds these funds. See /terms/cgv for withdrawal rules.

Individuals: valid ID + proof of address (<3 months) + proof of financial capacity. Entities (companies, funds): company registration equivalent (<3 months) + articles of association + representative's ID + UBO declaration (≥25%) + regulatory licence if applicable.

The data room is a secure space containing the asset's complete documents (grade report, audited financials, IP contracts, technical documentation). Accessible only to member buyers who have signed the asset-specific NDA. Every consultation is timestamped and logged.

items.q: When and how are session results published?
items.a: Results are published on /auction/results within 30 days of each session closing, in anonymised form: grade, category, sector, valuation range (±20%), process duration. No identities are disclosed.

AEGRYN Sessions are private transaction events held twice a year in Switzerland. 6 to 10 Grade A or above certified assets are presented to a closed circle of qualified member buyers. Access is by invitation only.
Use the "Forgot password" link on /client/login. A reset email will be sent within 5 minutes.

items.q: How do I update my KYC information?
items.a: Via the "My Profile" section of your client space. Updated documents are submitted to AEGRYN for re-validation.
